name: @kitora/dock
description: Kitora's docking engine: an n-ary layout model with a pure reducer and size solver, the one SplitView splitter, tab groups, floating windows and popouts, and React bindings with styled parts.

exports.name: ACTION_TYPES
exports.description:
Every change to the layout (DK119): the reducer is the only writer, and each
member here is one `DockAction` variant, among them `maximize`,
`restore-size`, `set-border`, `set-view-mode`,
`set-layout-locked` (edit mode, DK80), and `float`, `popout`, `dock`
and `set-float-bounds` (DK55–DK64).

exports.name: DOCK_SCHEMA_VERSION
exports.description: The schema version this build writes. Bump it with a `DockMigrator` from the previous value.

exports.name: DROP_ZONES
exports.description:
Where a drop lands (DK30–DK34, DK41, DK51): a group's centre
(join), one of its four edges (split), its tab strip at an index, one of the
dock's outer edges (a full-width or full-height split), a border, or
`float` (dropped outside the dock: a new floating window, DK41).

exports.name: GROUP_ZONES
exports.description: The zones of one group body: its centre and its four edges (what `hitZone` returns).

exports.name: KEYBOARD_DOCK_KEYS
exports.description:
Keys that step a keyboard docking cursor (DK104): the four arrows move
between a group's zones and on to the next group in that direction (visual
directions, mirrored to logical sides under RTL by the caller); `next` and
`previous` (Tab / Shift+Tab) jump between groups in reading order.

exports.name: LIFECYCLES
exports.description:
When a panel's content mounts and unmounts (DK83–DK87).
`lazy` (the default) mounts on first show and keeps the panel alive until it
closes; `eager` mounts with the dock; `unmount-when-hidden` mounts only while
the panel is the active tab of its group.

exports.name: MAXIMIZE_MODES
exports.description: How a maximised node fills the dock (DK44, DK45): with its tab strip, or `zen` (the active panel alone).

exports.name: NODE_KINDS
exports.description: What a node in the layout tree is. Borders and floats (popouts included) are not tree nodes: they live in the layout's `borders` and `floats`.

exports.name: ORIENTATIONS
exports.description: Split direction: `horizontal` lays children left to right (a row), `vertical` top to bottom (a column).

exports.name: PANEL_KINDS
exports.description: Document or tool panel (DK91): documents live in the editor area, tools in side and bottom areas.

exports.name: POPOUT_KINDS
exports.description:
How a popout opens (DK59, DK60): a plain browser window (`window.open`) or a
Document Picture-in-Picture window (always on top, no popup blocker; Chromium
only, feature-detected, falls back to `window`).

exports.name: PRIORITIES
exports.description:
Who absorbs the change when a split's container grows or shrinks (DK9, VS
Code's LayoutPriority): `high` panes take the delta first, then `normal`, then
`low`, so a `low` side bar keeps its width while a `high` editor stretches.

exports.name: RESTORE_OUTCOMES
exports.description:
The result of loading saved JSON (DK73, DK74): `ok`; `ok-with-placeholders`
when some panel names a component the host no longer registers (it restores
as an `UnknownPanel` placeholder); `migrated` when a migrator chain lifted an
older schema; `rejected` when the JSON is unusable, in which case the
previous layout stays live.

exports.name: SIDES
exports.description: A side of a node: where a split places a new neighbour, or which edge of the root a panel docks to.

exports.name: TAB_POSITIONS
exports.description: Where a group's tab strip sits (DK23); `left` and `right` stack the tabs vertically.

exports.name: VIEW_MODES
exports.description:
Where a tool panel lives (DK54, JetBrains' taxonomy): `docked` (a tab in a
group or a pinned border view that pushes the content aside) or `unpinned`
(a border view that overlays the content and hides when focus leaves, DK50).
A panel in a floating window or a popout has no view mode of its own: it lives in the layout's `floats`.

exports.name: ActionType
exports.description: The `type` of a `DockAction`, one of `ACTION_TYPES`.

exports.name: DropZone
exports.description: Where a drop lands, one of `DROP_ZONES`.

exports.name: GroupZone
exports.description: A zone of one group body, one of `GROUP_ZONES`.

exports.name: KeyboardDockKey
exports.description: A key that steps the keyboard docking cursor, one of `KEYBOARD_DOCK_KEYS`.

exports.name: Lifecycle
exports.description: When a panel's content mounts and unmounts, one of `LIFECYCLES`.

exports.name: MaximizeMode
exports.description: How a maximised node fills the dock, one of `MAXIMIZE_MODES`.

exports.name: NodeKind
exports.description: A layout node kind, one of `NODE_KINDS`.

exports.name: Orientation
exports.description: A split direction, one of `ORIENTATIONS`.

exports.name: PanelKind
exports.description: Document or tool panel, one of `PANEL_KINDS`.

exports.name: PopoutKind
exports.description: How a popout opens, one of `POPOUT_KINDS`.

exports.name: Priority
exports.description: Who absorbs a split's container resize first, one of `PRIORITIES`.

exports.name: RestoreOutcome
exports.description: The result of loading saved JSON, one of `RESTORE_OUTCOMES`.

exports.name: Side
exports.description: A side of a node or of the dock, one of `SIDES`.

exports.name: TabPosition
exports.description: Where a group's tab strip sits, one of `TAB_POSITIONS`.

exports.name: ViewMode
exports.description: Where a tool panel lives, one of `VIEW_MODES`.

exports.name: BorderState
exports.description:
A border (DK46–DK50): a docked strip along one side of the dock holding
collapsible views, e.g. VS Code's activity bar with its side bar (left), a
secondary side bar (right) or the bottom panel. Its panels live in
`DockLayout.panels` like any other; the border only orders them and says
which one is open. Borders sit outside the split tree, so maximising or
re-splitting the main area never moves them.

props.name: panels
props.description: The border's views in bar order.

props.name: open
props.description: The open view; null while the border is collapsed to its bar (DK47).

props.name: sizePx
props.description: The open view's size in px across the border (width for left / right, height for top / bottom).

props.name: last
props.description: The view that was open last, reopened by a toggle (Mod+B / Mod+J in VS Code).

exports.name: Borders
exports.description: The four borders, each optional (DK49: primary side bar, secondary side bar, bottom panel, and top).

exports.name: DockAction
exports.description:
Every change to the layout, one variant per `ACTION_TYPES` entry (DK119).
Hosts may veto any of them before it applies (DK122) through the React
layer's `onAction`; `reduce` itself never refuses a well-formed action except
where the layout forbids it (a locked group, a non-closable panel), and then
returns the same object (DK134).

exports.name: DockLayout
exports.description: The whole layout as plain JSON.

exports.name: DockNode
exports.description: A node of the layout tree: a split or a group.

exports.name: DropTarget
exports.description:
Where an added or moved panel lands.
- `group`: into a group's tabs at `index` (default: after the active tab).
- `split`: into a new group beside `node` on `side` (a node is a group or a split).
- `root`: into a new group along one edge of the whole dock.
- `border`: into the border on `side` at `index` (default the end), opened (DK51).
- `float`: into a new floating window (DK41, DK55), or a real browser window with `popout` (DK59).

exports.name: FloatBounds
exports.description: A rectangle in px: dock-relative for an in-page float, screen coordinates for a popout (DK64).

exports.name: FloatState
exports.description:
A floating sub-layout (DK55, DK58): its own tree of splits and groups
(`root`, nodes in `DockLayout.nodes` like the main tree's), shown in a
`@kitora/windows` window over the dock, or in a real browser window when
`popout` is set (DK59, DK60). Floats sit outside the main tree,
like borders, so maximising or re-splitting the main area never moves them.

props.name: root
props.description: The float's own tree: a group, or a split of groups.

props.name: bounds
props.description: The window's position and size: dock-relative in the page, screen coordinates for a popout (DK64).

props.name: popout
props.description: Set while the float lives in a real browser window; absent for an in-page window.

props.name: home
props.description: The group the content came from; docking back without a target returns there when it still exists (DK63).

exports.name: GroupNode
exports.description: A stack of panels with a tab strip (DK14).

exports.name: JsonObject
exports.description: A JSON object: the shape of panel params.

exports.name: JsonValue
exports.description: Any JSON value: panel params must survive `JSON.stringify` → `JSON.parse` unchanged (DK77).

exports.name: NodeId
exports.description: The id of a split or group node in `DockLayout.nodes`.

exports.name: PaneConstraints
exports.description:
How a node behaves as one pane of its parent split (DK4–DK9). Every field is
optional; absent means "no limit" or the default. Pixel values, because a
side bar's useful width does not scale with the window, while the stored
size stays a fraction (DK5).

exports.name: PanelId
exports.description: The id of a panel in `DockLayout.panels`.

exports.name: PanelInit
exports.description: A panel to add: everything but the id is optional except the component.

exports.name: PanelState
exports.description: One panel: what renders it, its title and its saved params (DK77).

props.name: id
props.description: The panel's id, unique in the layout.

props.name: component
props.description: The registry key of the component that renders it; an unregistered key renders the `UnknownPanel` placeholder (DK73).

props.name: title
props.description: The text on the panel's tab.

props.name: params
props.description: Saved, JSON-safe data the panel's component reads; kept across moves and saves (DK77).

props.name: kind
props.description: Document or tool panel (DK91).

props.name: lifecycle
props.description: When the panel's content mounts and unmounts; absent means `lazy` (mount on first show, keep alive).

props.name: closable
props.description: DK28: false hides the close control and refuses `close-panel`.

props.name: draggable
props.description: DK28: false keeps the tab where it is.

props.name: viewMode
props.description: DK54: where a tool panel lives; absent means `docked`. Read by borders: an `unpinned` view overlays the content (DK50).

exports.name: SplitNode
exports.description: A row (`horizontal`) or column (`vertical`) of two or more children (after normalisation).

exports.name: borderOf
exports.description: The side of the border holding panel `panel`, or null.

exports.name: DEFAULT_BORDER_PX
exports.description: Size of a border's open view when the border is created by a drop, px (VS Code's side bar default is about this).

exports.name: DEFAULT_FLOAT_BOUNDS
exports.description: Where a new float opens when no bounds are given, dock-relative px; each further float cascades by `FLOAT_CASCADE_PX`.

exports.name: emptyLayout
exports.description: An empty layout: no nodes, no panels; the dock shows its watermark (DK27).

exports.name: floatOf
exports.description: The float whose tree holds node `id` (a group or split), or null when it sits in the main tree or nowhere.

exports.name: groupOf
exports.description: The group holding panel `panel`, or null.

exports.name: normalize
exports.description: Normalises a layout built by hand (or restored) without applying an action.

exports.name: parentOf
exports.description: The split holding `id` as a child, or null for the root or an unknown id.

exports.name: reduce
exports.description:
Applies `action` to `layout` (DK119). Pure, never throws on a well-formed
action, normalises the result (DK133) and returns `layout` itself when
nothing changed (DK134).

exports.name: DEFAULT_ZONE_GEOMETRY
exports.description: The defaults: a quarter of the body for each edge band, 24–120 px, 12 px root bands, half for a split, a quarter at the root.

exports.name: edgeBand
exports.description: The band width along an axis of `size` px. Never more than half the size, so the centre never vanishes entirely. Exported for the devtools' zone overlay (DK127).

exports.name: hitZone
exports.description:
The zone of `rect` (a group body) under `point`, or null when the point is
outside it. `allowEdges: false` (a locked layout, or a group that refuses
splits) reports `center` everywhere inside.
exports.signature: (rect: ZoneRect, point: ZonePoint, geometry?: ZoneGeometry, allowEdges?: boolean) => GroupZone | null

exports.name: previewRect
exports.description: The part of `rect` a drop on `zone` would occupy: the whole rect for the centre, `share` of it along the side otherwise (DK33).
exports.signature: (rect: ZoneRect, zone: GroupZone, share: number) => ZoneRect

exports.name: rootZone
exports.description: The dock edge whose root band holds `point` (DK32), or null. Corners go to the nearer edge.
exports.signature: (dock: ZoneRect, point: ZonePoint, geometry?: ZoneGeometry) => Side | null

exports.name: ZoneGeometry
exports.description: Tunable zone sizes (DK40); every field has a default in `DEFAULT_ZONE_GEOMETRY`.

exports.name: ZonePoint
exports.description: A pointer position in px, in the same coordinates as `ZoneRect`.

exports.name: ZoneRect
exports.description: A group's rectangle in px, as `hitZone` measures it.

exports.name: createLayoutLibrary
exports.description: Wraps a named store as a `LayoutLibrary`: saves serialize, opens go through `restore`.

exports.name: layoutSlot
exports.description: One name of a store as a single slot (what `<Dock storage>` takes).

exports.name: memoryLayoutStore
exports.description: An in-memory named store: tests, demos, or a session-only app. Values are copied through JSON so a later edit never leaks in.

exports.name: memoryStorage
exports.description: An in-memory slot.

exports.name: DockLayoutStore
exports.description: Named layouts (DK75). Names are the host's (e.g. "Debug", "Review").

exports.name: DockStorageAdapter
exports.description: One saved-layout slot (tabster's adapter shape). Reads may return any JSON; `restore` validates it.

exports.name: LayoutLibrary
exports.description: Named layouts over a store, with restore's checks on the way in.

exports.name: MaybePromise
exports.description: A value or a promise of it: storage adapters may answer synchronously or asynchronously.

exports.name: dragSash
exports.description:
Moves the sash between panes `index` and `index + 1` by `delta` px (DK3).
Space comes from the panes on the shrinking side, nearest first, each down
to its minimum, and goes to the nearest pane on the growing side, then the
next, each up to its maximum (VS Code's cascading sash), so a long drag
pushes past a pane that has hit its limit. A collapsible neighbour dragged
below half of its minimum snaps closed, and a collapsed one dragged out past
that point snaps open at its minimum (DK6, DK7).

exports.name: fractionsOf
exports.description:
Stored fractions from pixel sizes (DK5). Open panes get their share of the
open space; a collapsed pane keeps its previous fraction (what it expands
back to). The result sums to 1.
exports.signature: (px: readonly number[], collapsed: readonly boolean[], previous: readonly number[]) => number[]

exports.name: normalizeFractions
exports.description: Fractions scaled to sum to 1 (equal shares when all are zero or invalid).

exports.name: solveSizes
exports.description:
Pixel sizes for every pane of a split in a container of `containerPx`
(already net of sashes). Always returns non-negative sizes that sum to
`containerPx` (for a container ≥ 0), whatever the constraints.

exports.name: SashDragInput
exports.description: A sash drag in progress: the state at pointer-down, which every move is computed from (so a drag is reversible).

exports.name: SashDragResult
exports.description: The sizes and collapsed flags after a sash drag.

exports.name: SolverInput
exports.description: A split's state for the solver: one entry per child, plus the container px the sizes were committed at.

exports.name: SolverPane
exports.description: One pane as the solver sees it.

exports.name: restore
exports.description:
Restores a layout from saved JSON (a string or a parsed value). Never throws
(DK74): unusable input returns `rejected` with `options.fallback`.

exports.name: serialize
exports.description: The layout as JSON-safe data with the current schema version.

exports.name: DockMigrator
exports.description: Lifts saved JSON from schema `from` to `to`. Chains run one step at a time.

exports.name: RestoreOptions
exports.description: Options for `restore`: the fallback layout, the registered component keys and the migrators.

exports.name: RestoreResult
exports.description: What `restore` returns: the outcome, the layout to use, and why.

exports.name: checkInvariants
exports.description: Every rule the layout breaks, as `path: problem` lines; empty when the layout is valid.

exports.name: createLayout
exports.description:
Builds a normalised `DockLayout` from a nested spec (or null for an empty
dock). Panel ids must be unique across the whole spec; a repeated id keeps
its first occurrence.

exports.name: BorderSpec
exports.description: A border in a layout spec (DK47): its views in bar order, which one is open (null: collapsed), and the open size.

exports.name: GroupSpec
exports.description: A group in a layout spec: its panels in tab order, which one is active, and its pane settings.

exports.name: LayoutExtras
exports.description: Everything around the main tree.

exports.name: LayoutSpec
exports.description: A node of a layout spec for `createLayout`: a split or a group.

exports.name: SplitSpec
exports.description: A split in a layout spec.

exports.name: allGroups
exports.description: The main area's groups, then each float's (DK55), in float order: what group numbers (Mod+1…9) count.

exports.name: groupsInOrder
exports.description: Every group reachable from the main root, in tree order (left to right, top to bottom). Floats are not included.

exports.name: groupsUnder
exports.description: Every group at or below node `id`, in tree order.

exports.name: layoutOutline
exports.description: The layout as one line of text; `(empty)` for an empty dock.

exports.name: keyboardDockStep
exports.description: The cursor after one key (DK104). `groups` lists every group the drop may target, in reading order.
exports.signature: (cursor: DockCursor, key: KeyboardDockKey, groups: readonly GroupRect[]) => DockCursor

exports.name: keyboardDockTarget
exports.description: The drop target a cursor stands for; `rtl` mirrors the visual left / right into logical sides (DK108).

exports.name: mirrorSide
exports.description: Left and right swapped (RTL); top and bottom unchanged.

exports.name: DockCursor
exports.description: Where a keyboard drop would land: a group's zone, or an outer edge of the main area (remembering the group it came from).

exports.name: GroupRect
exports.description: A group and where it is on screen.

exports.name: createPanelHost
exports.description: A host for one dock, creating elements in `doc` (the opener's document by default).

exports.name: PANEL_ATTR
exports.description: The attribute every panel element carries, valued with the panel id.

exports.name: supportsStatePreservingMove
exports.description: True when this document can move a node without reloading its iframes (`Element.prototype.moveBefore`, DK85).

exports.name: PanelHost
exports.description: Keeps one live element per panel and moves it between group bodies, so content survives moves (keep-alive).

exports.name: observeBox
exports.description: Calls `onBox(width, height)` with `el`'s size whenever it changes (DK88's `resized` event); never for a zero box. Returns the disposer.
exports.signature: (el: Element, onBox: (width: number, height: number) => void) => () => void

exports.name: observeSize
exports.description:
Calls `onSize(px)` with `el`'s size along `orientation` now and whenever it
changes. Returns the disposer. Without ResizeObserver (old jsdom) it reports
once and never again.
exports.signature: (el: Element, orientation: Orientation, onSize: (px: number) => void) => () => void

exports.name: sizeAlong
exports.description: Inner size of `el` along `orientation` in CSS px (content box).

exports.name: canAnimateCommit
exports.description: True when a commit in `doc` should animate: the API exists and the user has not asked for reduced motion.

exports.name: commitWithTransition
exports.description: Runs `update` inside a view transition when `canAnimateCommit`, else at once.

exports.name: localStorageAdapter
exports.description: One slot in localStorage under `key`.

exports.name: localStorageLayoutStore
exports.description: Named layouts in localStorage, one key per name: `${prefix}${name}`.

exports.name: createDockAnnouncer
exports.description: A polite announcer whose region lives in `host` (the dock's root element).

exports.name: DOCK_ANNOUNCER_ATTR
exports.description: Marks the region, for tests and for hosts that move or style it.

exports.name: Dock
exports.description:
A docking layout of tab groups, splits, borders and floating windows, driven by one reducer.
Controlled with `layout` + `onLayoutChange`, or uncontrolled from `defaultLayout` or `<DockSplit>` / `<DockGroup>` / `<DockPanel>` children.

props.name: panels
props.description: Every component this dock can show, from `defineDockPanels` (DK123).

props.name: layout
props.description: Controlled layout (DK120); pair with `onLayoutChange`.

props.name: defaultLayout
props.description: Uncontrolled starting layout; wins over JSX children. Also what `reset()` returns to (DK71).

props.name: onLayoutChange
props.description: Every applied change, with the action that caused it (DK78).

props.name: onAction
props.description: Sees every action before it applies, with the layout it would produce; return false to veto (DK122).

props.name: beforeClose
props.description: Asked before a panel closes, e.g. "save changes?" (DK22); false or a promise of false keeps it open.

props.name: accept
props.description: Drop acceptance (DK39); the default keeps documents out of borders (DK91).

props.name: geometry
props.description: Drop-zone sizes (DK40).

props.name: animate
props.description: Whether drops and maximise animate with View Transitions (DK37); always off under reduced motion.

props.name: onExternalDrop
props.description: Turns a native drop from outside the dock (files, links) into a panel, or null to refuse (DK38). Payloads from `dockDragSourceProps` need no handler.

props.name: storage
props.description: Where the layout is saved and restored from (DK76). Restored once on mount; saved after each change.

props.name: migrators
props.description: Lift older saved layouts; used by `storage`, `load()` and the persistence helpers.

props.name: onRestore
props.description: The outcome of the mount-time restore from `storage` (also called when nothing was saved, with `rejected`).

props.name: onPanelEvent
props.description: Every panel event (DK88): shown, hidden, active, inactive, resized, moved.

props.name: parts
props.description: Presentation parts; the ui layer's `DOCK_UI` gives the styled set.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, used in group region labels.

props.name: popoutHost
props.description: Opens real windows for `popout` (DK59, DK60); `browserPopoutHost()` from `@kitora/dock/popout`. Without one, pop-outs float in the page.

props.name: onPopoutBlocked
props.description: The browser blocked a popout (or there is no host), so the panel floats in the page instead (DK67); the dock also announces it.

props.name: messages
props.description: Replaces announcement texts (DK102).

props.name: announce
props.description: Where announcements go; default the dock's own polite live region (DK102).

props.name: ref
props.description: The imperative API (DK121).

props.name: children
props.description: Declarative default layout (DK118).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class names for the dock's root element.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the dock's root element.

exports.name: DOCK_SAVE_DELAY_MS
exports.description: Default delay before a change is written to `storage`, ms: one write per burst of changes (a sash drag commits once anyway).

exports.name: DockBorder
exports.description: A border along one side. Renders nothing; read by `<Dock>`.

props.name: side
props.description: The side of the dock the border runs along.

props.name: open
props.description: The open view's id; null starts collapsed; default the first view.

props.name: sizePx
props.description: The open view's size in px across the border; absent means `DEFAULT_BORDER_PX`.

props.name: children
props.description: The border's `<DockPanel>` children, in bar order.

exports.name: DockGroup
exports.description: A tab group. Renders nothing; read by `<Dock>`.

props.name: id
props.description: The group's node id; generated when omitted.

props.name: size
props.description: Fraction of the parent split.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Whether the group starts collapsed to its `collapsedPx`.

props.name: locked
props.description: Whether the group refuses reorders, drops, closing and splitting (DK28).

props.name: keepWhenEmpty
props.description: Whether the group stays, showing its watermark, after its last panel closes (DK27).

props.name: tabPosition
